title: Align scheduled-send exception logging regression test
description: python/tests/loadng/test_rreq_jitter.py::test_link_send_exception_is_logged_and_re_raised fails because Node.scheduled_send now logs the more general 'scheduled send failed (delay=...)' while still preserving the exception and traceback; the test requires the obsolete literal 'scheduled_send: link.send failed'. Choose and document the public diagnostic contract, then update the implementation/test consistently without weakening the checks that the error is logged and re-raised.
